The Oracle: The landmark is the White House

The Subtask Name: Retrieve the height of the White House
Step Range: 2-3
The Oracle: The height is 70 feet
Evidence: Web search confirmed the White House height is 70 feet on the south side.

The Subtask Name: Calculate height in yards and round
Step Range: 3-4
The Oracle: 23
Evidence: Code converted 70 feet to yards (70/3 ≈ 23.33) and rounded to the nearest integer (23).

Explanation: The height retrieval (S2) depends on knowing the specific landmark identified in S1 to query the correct dimensions.

}
consistency_score: 0.98

  -- Result: Calculated final answer of 23 yards.
